purpose: Held next-version configuration for the complete current native system with optional Reviewer-selected local full-utterance ASR. It is not registered for execution and declares no final new live-ASR contact, audio, GPU, or scoring budget.

pending_root_bindings.generation_execution_plan: Root will bind a new prospective generation plan after current-pair conclusion; no final budget is frozen here.
pending_root_bindings.native_contact_fit: Baseline carries the inherited exact 44000 endpoint formula with fresh prospective identities; root must register and rebind it before any worker stage.
pending_root_bindings.live_asr_execution_plan: Required before adding the runtime live_speech_observations binding. Contact and audio ceilings are intentionally unset.
pending_root_bindings.exposure_ledger: No row is created by this draft.
pending_root_bindings.official_scoring: No scoring job, scorer contact, or analysis registration is created by this draft.
pending_root_bindings.cpu_resource_envelope: cpu_workers=4 currently bounds audio preparation. At activation, also pin CPU library thread limits in the worker launch environment and record them; do not describe the existing field as an inference-thread cap.

generation_budget.definition: Inherited current-system generation envelope for configuration composition only. These are ceilings, not forced calls, and do not set any live-ASR budget.
